newsitem.title: USA: PG&E says 37,000 customers without power.
newsitem.headline: PG&E says 37,000 customers without power.

text.p: Pacific Gas and Electric Co said about 37,000 of its customers in northern and central California were without power Tuesday because of problems caused by a storm.
Many of those affected by the outage were in California's central valley and the rest were scattered around PG&E's service area, spokesman David Bicha said.
Northern California was hit by a storm overnight and the storm was moving south, leaving a trail of power outages in its wake, Bicha said.
The outages were caused by trees falling across power lines and other weather-related problems, he said.
PG&E had crews out working and they had already restored power to many customers affected by the outages, he said.
The peak number of customers without power at any one time was about 38,000, Bicha said, but he did not have a total of all the customers who had been affected.
He said about 12,000 customers in San Jose were without power for two hours but had now been reconnected.
